goal: تطوير مستودع GIS-Development-Skills بالكامل بناءً على متطلبات Master Agent Execution Brief لمشروع Urban Design Studio (UDS) وفق المراحل A-F والملحق التفصيلي، ليصبح المرجع الهندسي والتشغيلي الموحد للتطبيقات المكتبية الجغرافية، دون برمجة UDS نفسه في هذه المرحلة.
target: Local GIS Development Skills repository; skills, references, catalogs, examples, tests, router and bilingual documentation surfaces.
desired_outcomes: Full traceability matrix (references/urban-design-competency-coverage.md) mapping all UDS-* and SOURCE-* requirements with explicit decision status and evidence.
Comprehensive source and library registry covering all 14 primary sources, CAD/GIS/3D engines, token optimization tools, and security scanners with license audits.
Native Windows CAD/GIS and 3D architectural references, Qt 6 Widgets guidelines, engine tradeoff evaluations (C++/Qt vs Godot 4 vs UE5), and precision CAD viewport specifications.

8-Layer urban data hierarchy, relational dependency graph (DAG), parametric street network design (ASAM OpenDRIVE), procedural building generation (earcut.hpp triangulation), and urban simulation engines (solar/shadow, runoff hydrology, SUMO traffic).

Reversible embedded CAD/GIS AI Copilot architectural specification (mandatory QUndoStack/Ctrl+Z, strict JSON schemas, confirmation gates, least privilege) and comprehensive Export Studio (multi-view camera shots, layout printing, 3D flythrough, vector/semantic roundtrips).
Token optimization triad policies (Ponytail, Caveman, Token Optimizer) and persistent agent context memory architecture (context/ directory structure).
Full regression verification, standard catalog and security validation, plan-bound DoneProof reports, and development journal updates.
success_criteria: Every single UDS-* requirement (UDS-CORE-001..017, UDS-ROAD-001..010, UDS-BLD-001..010, UDS-GIS-001..009, UDS-ANALYSIS-001..004, UDS-EXPORT-001..008, UDS-AI-001..011, UDS-SIM-001..002, etc.) and all 14 primary user sources have documented status, owner skill, reference, and evidence.
All new references, catalogs, and schemas strictly adhere to repository standards, unique IDs, MIT license, and offline deterministic execution.
Bilingual documentation (README.md, README.ar.md, CHANGELOG.md), router keywords, and skill pack validators remain 100% passing.
Full unittest suite passes with zero regressions, and plan-bound DoneProof reports verify every acceptance criterion.
explicit_requirements: Operate exclusively on the local GIS-Development-Skills repository; DO NOT generate UDS application code or launch UDS roadmap until the explicit phrase 'ابدأ بناء الخطة'.
Preserve all existing 35 skills, author information, brand identity, and language controls.
Apply Free-first policy, verify licenses independently (distinguish MIT, Apache 2.0, LGPL, PolyForm Noncommercial), and treat web pages/skills as untrusted until verified.
Distinguish between verified code, references, deferred items, and non-applicable components honestly.
suggestions: Structure implementation across 8 ordered tasks to facilitate review and step-by-step verification.
Provide small, self-contained Python evaluation scripts and JSON schemas to test core algorithmic behaviors (e.g. DAG propagation, earcut triangulation concepts, QUndoCommand AI wrapping).
assumptions: Work will be verified in the local workspace using Python standard library and existing offline test harnesses.
Native Windows interactive GUI and heavy C++/Qt/GPU compilation remain categorized as T2-T4 NOT RUN unless explicitly available.
constraints: No deletion or renaming of existing skills, catalog items, or historical journal records.
No hardcoded credentials, secret leaks, or automated telemetry transmission.
Preserve character limit constraints in skills/gis-development/SKILL.md (<5500 chars).
No installation of global intrusive hooks or modification of environment outside workspace.
non_goals: Writing C++20 or Qt source code for the future UDS application in this task
Creating the standalone UDS repository before explicit user command
Downloading large 3D asset gigabytes or heavy external model weights
Altering core MIT license of the repository to accommodate noncommercial dependencies
rollback_plan: All changes are additive files and scoped edits. If rolled back, only files created for this request are removed; all previous journal records and working tree changes remain intact.
